in_marathi.name: Ahaana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Shining, Dazzling
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahaana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahaana is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ah’, meaning radiant or shining, and ‘ana’, meaning towards or towards me. This name evokes the image of a bright and luminous being, who illuminates the path for others.
